mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (oprt_std_id) oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym,oprt_std_nm,num_val,txt_val,unit_nm,use_plc_desc FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND oprt_std_id IN ('SIG_DELAY_WARN','SIG_DELAY_RISK','SIG_COST_WARN','SIG_COST_RISK','SIG_STALE_DAYS','BUDGET_RATE', 'DISPATCH_MAX_MONTHS','DISPATCH_ALERT_DAYS','PLAN_GAP_TOLERANCE') ORDER BY oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym DESC

SELECT p.prj_id,p.prj_no,p.prj_nm,c.ptnr_nm AS "custName",p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.bsn_part_id, coalesce(d.dev_nm,'PM 미지정') AS "pmName",p.cur_cntrct_amt,p.trgt_cst_amt,p.prfm_bgn_dt, m.wrt_dt AS last_memo_dt,m.actl_prgs_rt, (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.issue i WHERE i.prj_id=p.prj_id AND i.issue_stts_cd IN ('OPEN','DOING')) AS open_issue_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.issue i WHERE i.prj_id=p.prj_id AND i.issue_stts_cd IN ('OPEN','DOING') AND i.svrt_cd='HIGH') AS high_open_issue_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.issue i WHERE i.prj_id=p.prj_id AND i.issue_stts_cd!='CLOSED' AND i.ddln_dt < #{today}) AS overdue_issue_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.issue i WHERE i.prj_id=p.prj_id AND i.issue_stts_cd!='CLOSED' AND i.ddln_dt < #{today} AND i.svrt_cd='HIGH') AS high_overdue_count FROM prj.prj p LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=p.pm_dev_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT wrt_dt,actl_prgs_rt FROM prj.wkly_memo w WHERE w.prj_id=p.prj_id ORDER BY wrt_dt DESC,memo_id DESC LIMIT 1) m ON true WHERE p.use_yn='Y' AND (p.prj_stts_cd='RUN' OR (p.prj_stts_cd='PLAN' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.prj_id=p.prj_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today}))) ORDER BY p.prj_id
SELECT phs_id,prj_id,phs_seq,phs_nm,wght_rt,plan_bgn_dt,plan_end_dt,cmpl_dt,NULL::text AS status FROM prj.phs WHERE prj_id=#{id} ORDER BY phs_seq,phs_id

WITH project_mm AS ( SELECT a.dev_id,m.work_ym,sum(m.mm_qty) AS mm FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id WHERE a.prj_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND m.work_ym <= #{month} GROUP BY a.dev_id,m.work_ym ), person_mm AS ( SELECT a.dev_id,m.work_ym,sum(m.mm_qty) AS mm FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id WHERE a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND m.work_ym <= #{month} GROUP BY a.dev_id,m.work_ym ), labor AS ( SELECT p.work_ym AS month,sum(floor(coalesce(s.indv_lbr_cst_amt,0)::numeric*p.mm/greatest(t.mm,1.00))) AS amount, bool_or(s.mth_cst_id IS NULL AND p.mm>0) AS missing_salary FROM project_mm p JOIN person_mm t ON t.dev_id=p.dev_id AND t.work_ym=p.work_ym LEFT JOIN cst.mth_cst s ON s.dev_id=p.dev_id AND s.cst_ym=p.work_ym GROUP BY p.work_ym ), expenses AS ( SELECT expns_ym AS month,sum(expns_amt)::numeric AS amount FROM cst.drct_expns WHERE prj_id=#{id} AND expns_ym <= #{month} GROUP BY expns_ym ), closed AS ( SELECT a.cst_ym AS month,sum(a.lbr_cst_amt::numeric+a.drct_expns_amt) AS amount FROM cst.cst_aloc a JOIN fin.mth_cls f ON f.cls_ym=a.cst_ym AND f.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED' WHERE a.prj_id=#{id} AND a.cst_ym <= #{month} GROUP BY a.cst_ym ), months AS (SELECT month FROM labor UNION SELECT month FROM expenses UNION SELECT month FROM closed) SELECT m.month,CASE WHEN c.month IS NOT NULL THEN c.amount ELSE coalesce(l.amount,0)+coalesce(e.amount,0) END AS amount, CASE WHEN c.month IS NOT NULL THEN false ELSE coalesce(l.missing_salary,false) END AS missing_salary FROM months m LEFT JOIN labor l ON l.month=m.month LEFT JOIN expenses e ON e.month=m.month LEFT JOIN closed c ON c.month=m.month ORDER BY m.month
